141001.description:
Midori first met Natsume by the ginkgo trees near his apartment back when he was in high school and had been in love with him ever since. The two had become friends during all those years, with Natsume none the wiser of Midori's feelings for him. Now adults, Natsume is engaged and soon to be married, leaving a pining Midori trying to move on and bury his feelings. Though, that is easier said than done. To complicate things, it seems that Natsume is starting to notice his unusual behavior.

(Source: Futekiya)

title.native: よるにきんのあめのふる
title.romaji: Yoru ni Kin no Ame no Furu

141002.description:
Ryosuke is a 27 year old gay man who frequents the bar staffed by Reo, a bartender known for sleeping around. Despite the warnings given to him by the bar owner and patrons alike, Ryosuke finds himself attracted to Reo. When Reo approaches Ryosuke while he drinks alone in the bar on his birthday, the two engage in a one-night stand, of which Ryosuke barely remembers due to his drunken state. When he learns Reo is kicked out by the guy he lived with, Ryosuke offers Reo to live with him and the two start a somewhat domestic relationship. Though, can a love that started with a one-night stand really last?

(Source: Futekiya)

title.native: ネコなんていつも気まぐれ

141003.description:
Ryo and Mihoko are a newly married couple who move to Kamakura… but they are not alone in this adventure, because they are accompanied by their five cats!

The seven make up the entire Katagiri family. A heartwarming comedy that will make you love cats even more!
synonyms: Diario de nuestra vida entre gatos en Kamakura

title.native: 猫とふたりの鎌倉手帖
title.romaji: Neko to Futari no Kamakura Techou

141004.description:
Follow the daily life of Katagiri-kun who lives alone with his cats.

Note: It was originally serialized in Comic Bunch but moved to Comic@Bunch on January 21, 2011.

title.native: 片桐くん家に猫がいる
title.romaji: Katagiri-kun Chi ni Neko ga Iru

141007.description:
[Will you join the game?] Giyoung's suddenly thrown into a game of life and death. Not only that but he's also the player with the lowest stats. Still, he's got one skill on his side: the ability to read other players' status! He finds the opportunity of his life when he discovers that Hyunsung is a returner to this world. Now all Giyoung has to do is stick next to Hyunsung and game his way out of this tutorial.

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: คู่มือการใช้งานของนักข้ามเวลา

1. Kobu Shoujo (肉瘤少女)
2-3. Tenkousei (転校生)

141011.description:
An unknown voice disturbed me while I was levitating during my cultivation to reach the transcendent demonic state.

My concentration had been broken, and I fell into an unconscious, overloaded state. When I awoke a month later, the Lich King had already taken control of the Murim.

After the battle that ended with the destruction of the Heavenly Demon Cult, I awoke a hundred and forty years later in a Murim where magic and martial arts coexisted.
synonyms: The Heavenly Demon Destroys the Lich King's Murim

141012.description:
A collection of stories:

1. Taiji Ihen: Watashi no Aka-chan (胎児異変 わたしの赤ちゃん)
2. Akai Hana (赤い花)
3. Mari Tsuki Shoujo (まりつき少女)
4. Manatsu Gensou (真夏・幻想); Young Comic 1972-12-07
5. Ganjitsu no Asa (元日の朝)
6. Okashi na Okashi na Production (おかしなおかしなプロダクション)
7. Mizuiro no Heya (水色の部屋)

title.native: 胎児異変 わたしの赤ちゃん

141013.description:
I thought I’d finally escaped my hellish life when I died in an airplane crash, but I fell into another nightmare when I awoke as Rudbeckia de Borgia, a minor villain from a historical novel destined to die at the hands of her husband, Iske van Omerta. Surviving with the dysfunctional Borgia family is hard enough, but now I have to marry the man who will kill me! Still, it’s okay, I just have to convince Iske, his family, and all his countrymen that I’m completely harmless! How hard can that be?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: How to Get My Husband on My Side
วิธีดึงสามีมาเป็นพวก
Como Fazer de Um Marido Uma Aliança

title.english: How to Win My Husband Over

141015.description: One day, a devil comes for me? A stunning tale of co-habitation with a cute devil.

141016.description:
A girl who calls herself a demon appeared before a timid student named Fumio Kijima. The girl claims to be a campaign girl from the demon world and she gives him the ability to “summon a room” from nothing but thin air.

At first he doesn’t abuse his power and uses it as a convenient ability in his every day life. But one day he is bullied by his classmates under a false pretext and is made to suffer. In the past he would have wallowed in misery and cried himself to sleep, but now he had a power to call upon.

“I will make them regret it!”

Using his powers to summon his “room”, he begins his era of confinement and brainwashing to achieve his goals.

141017.description: For some reason, Komachi, an idol-otaku, has just debuted as an idol herself! She forms a group with Sora (anime-otaku) and Yuzuha (doujin author), but everyone's a beginner and an otaku!? Later on, Ayame (game-otaku) and Naru (otaku??) also join members, and things get really lively!

141018.description:
Born as a sick child, Gae-Ttong (dog poop) was given her ugly name so she would live long (in the old days people believed you needed an ugly name to live long). However, as she grows up she gets treated like her name. Her family is rich and full of geniuses except for her. Will things ever get better for her?

Note: Release dates match those of the volume release.

141019.description:
A-Ra is the owner of a famous restaurant in Gangnam, but she's secretly crazy about Jun-Min from the boy band "Shooting Stars"! She scouts out a new manager to help run her restaurant, but the truth is... the manager, Hyeon Min, is Jun Min's older brother! Can A-Ra keep her ulterior motives and secret fan-girl life under wraps, or will Hyeon turn out to be more than she bargained for?

(Source: TappyToon, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes 15 extra chapters that were released in 2019, years after the original release finished in 2013.

141020.description: Tsutomu Nihei's debut work, the one-shot prototype for BLAME! Won the Jiro Taniguchi Special Prize for 1995's Afternoon Four Seasons Awards.

141021.description: A collection of popular Japanese tales originally intended for children but revisited by the author to make little tales for adults. More than ever, Hanawa does not hesitate to mix the grotesque, the vulgar, the improbable with the marvelous, situation comedy and lyricism.

141022.description:
The legendary molester was commissioned... to deflower girls!? Just what could be these girls' reasons... to want a complete stranger to deflower them?

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 156 chapters and 52 episodes respectively.

title.native: 処女仲介人～奪ってほしい女達

141023.description:
A girl who calls herself a demon appeared before a timid student named Fumio Kijima. The girl claims to be a campaign girl from the demon world and she gives him the ability to “summon a room” from nothing but thin air.

At first he doesn’t abuse his power and uses it as a convenient ability in his every day life. But one day he is bullied by his classmates under a false pretext and is made to suffer. In the past he would have wallowed in misery and cried himself to sleep, but now he had a power to call upon.

“I will make them regret it!”

Using his powers to summon his “room”, he begins his era of confinement and brainwashing to achieve his goals.

141024.description: A collection of stories that everyone living with animals will sympathize with!

141025.description:
It's been a year since Ryuji Honjo graduated high school and started university. And so far, despite being recently dumped, he is having a grand old time. But what would his middle school self think about him now?... Meanwhile, Leo Ichinose, Ryuji's classmate in university, is as cool and reserved as ever. His unintentional glares scare people off. But something about him catches Ryuji's attention. Or... is it Ryuji who's caught Ichinose's attention? Ryuji swears he can feel his stares on him. Will the outgoing and charming Ryuji get along with the distant and unapproachable Ichinose? The two seem like polar opposites at first, but maybe they're not so different after all.

(Source: Futekiya)

title.english: Paint Love and the Colors Will Bloom
title.romaji: Koi wo Egakeba Iro ga Saku

141026.description:
Ayano is a newbie BL comic artist. She has been dating her boyfriend, Kazuki, for a year, and has been living with him for 3 weeks. But one day, Kazuki is finally fed up with Ayano's lifestyle, so he breaks up with her and leaves. Upset, Ayano goes out for a night of drinks. On her way back home, an old geezer tries to feel her up, but she's saved by her ex, Asahi. This and that happened, and now Asahi has moved in, and the two start living together. Is Ayano just pretending to not realize what Asahi is up to...? Or maybe they moved in together too soon?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Living With Asahi Has Me Smothered in Love
title.native: 旭くんとの暮らしは溺愛がすぎる
title.romaji: Asahi-kun to no Kurashi wa Dekiai ga Sugiru

141027.description:
Side story to Everyone Stand Up! Boys Love Private High School focusing on Tachibana and Mizuki. Set after the events of the main story, the story centers on Mizuki, still the hardworking student with the goal to be first place during the upcoming term. Though now on friendly terms with Sousuke, Mizuki has his own reasons for aiming for the top place, even if it means working with Toshiki who often gets on his nerves but has the same goal as his. As the 30th annual sports festival aka BL festival is announced, Mizuki and Toshiki become closer than ever, and Mizuki starts to realize his partnership with Toshiki may be more than just business.

(Source: Futekiya)
synonyms: Everyone stand up! Boys love private high school -Tachibana and Mizuki-

title.native: 全員起立! 私立BL学園高等学校～橘×ミズキ編～

An all-new yuri anthology featuring pure love stories of women and girls who meet on dating apps! Cover Illustration: Bana Yoshida

2. Cinderella (by Kazu Akizuki)

141031.description: <i>Note: This one-shot got first published on Jump SQ.CROWN Summer 2015 issue on July 17, 2015. It got re-published later on a digital format on Shounen Jump + on November 2, 2021.<i>

141032.description:
Mankind was destroyed by wars and natural disasters, and the only survivors were Gaia, and her children, Uranus, and Eros. While wandering around the desolate land, soon they come across a dome-shaped facility. There were advanced machines that they had never seen before and vegetation that had already gone extinct. Although they were relieved for a moment, suddenly something mysterious happens...!? A new Greek myth that tells the story of human rebirth.

(Source: Tokuma Shouten, translated)
synonyms: ゼウス ギリシャ神話 黎明編

141033.description: Promotional twitter manga for the light novel of the same name.

title.native: 俺の『運命の赤い糸』に繋がってたのは、天敵のような女子だった件
title.romaji: Ore no "Unmei no Akai Ito" ni Tsunagatteta no wa, Tenteki no youna Joshi datta Ken

141034.description:
A long war between humankind and machines has come to an end with the victory of the mankind. The injured combat robot "Shaian" loses its operator and falls asleep deeply. 1000 years have passed since then, and Shaian awakens in response to the girl Ikuuru. Shaian is completely revived with Ikuuru as its new operator! Shaian's greatest enemy is still alive and doing battle in Brazil. With a Ikuuru's help, Shaian may be able to stop this evil force before another war rages over the continent.

(Source: Asahi Sonorama, translated)

141035.description:
"My childhood friend is... pretty cute."
Yuusuke Hiyoshi, an ordinary high school boy, is Meiko Yashiro's childhood friend, the most feared Yankee girl at school!
Wanting to help her find some female friends, Yuusuke suggests, "Why don't you try shortening your skirt first?"
This is the Innocent Yankee Girl x Honor Student Childhood Friend's cute and complicated love comedy!

title.native: ヤンキーちゃんは素直になれない
あおたん！-青矢先輩と私の探偵部活動-
title.romaji: Aotan: Aoya-senpai to Watashi no Tantei-bu Katsudou

141037.description: Late-bloomer Gomi-sensei (Trash-sensei) has never even once dated a girl before. He's on lots of dating apps, trying desperately to somehow find a partner. But these precocious, modern elementary school students watch over their constantly anguished teacher…? They're supporting their unpopular teacher's dating life - it's a wholesome children's manga!
synonyms: 先生の婚活を皆で優しく見守る話

title.native: 先生、僕たちがついてます!

141038.description:
Reya is reborn as a princess with no magical powers, in a kingdom ruled by magic. However, she is discovered to have the power of purification, and as a saint, she is assigned to save the world with Kazuya, the summoned hero whom she fell in love at first sight! The two people from another world meeting for the first time should have been an emotional event! But Kazuya acts somewhat coldly towards Reya......?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: お荷物と呼ばれた転生姫は、召喚勇者に恋をして聖女になりました
title.romaji: Onimotsu to Yobareta Tensei Hime wa, Shoukan Yuusha ni Koi wo Shite Seijo ni Narimashita

141039.description:
In a kingdom where magical power is equal to the power to rule, Reya was reborn as a princess with no magic, and is forced to live her life in the shadows. However, when it was discovered that she has the same purifying power as a legendary saint, she is recruited to help the powerful hero, Kazuya, in the neighboring empire. Reya is happy to finally be of use to others, but the hero seems strangely cold and distant towards Reya...? This is a story between an unappreciated saint and the strongest hero, working together to find love and save the world.

(Source: Ura Sunday, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes two extra chapters.

title.native: お荷物と呼ばれた転生姫は、召喚勇者に恋をして聖女になりました
title.romaji: Onimotsu to Yobareta Tensei Hime wa, Shoukan Yuusha ni Koi wo Shite Seijo ni Narimashita

141041.description:
Visions of discarded dolls plague Chika's nights, following a foreboding encounter with a possessed doll resting among a collection of occult curiosities...

(Source: Glacier Bay Books)

title.english: Occult Detective Club: Graveyard of the Death Dolls
title.native: オカルト探偵団 死人形の墓場

synonyms: I like Takachiho Honoka-senpai so, so much that I can’t help myself!

title.native: 高千穂ほのか先輩が好きで好きで色々ガマンできない。
title.romaji: Takachiho Honoka Senpai ga Suki de Suki de Iroiro Gaman Dekinai.

141044.description:
As Ayanokouji and his classmates begin their second year at the Advanced Nurturing High School, they’re greeted by a fresh gauntlet of exams and a fresh batch of rather unique first-year students. They’ll have to get to know each other quickly, because the first special exam pairs the first-years with the second-years on a written test—with only the second-years facing expulsion if their team performs poorly! Worse yet? It seems one of the new first-years is also from the White Room. Can Ayanokouji avoid expulsion while sussing out the identity of this hidden foe?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

141045.description:
A compilation of new stories of the Pocket Monsters: Kimi ni Kimeta! movie, telling the encounter between Satoshi and Pikachu, the story of Marshadow and Ho-Oh.

1. Satoshi & Pikachu: Beginning (サトシ＆ピカチュウ ビギニング); CoroCoro Comic 2017-05
2. Moeyo Marshadow (燃えよマーシャドー); CoroCoro Comic 2017-07
3. Niji no Yuusha (虹の勇者); CoroCoro Comic 2017-08
4. Pikachu to Satoshi no Boushi (ピカチュウとサトシのぼうし); kakioroshi

title.native: 劇場版ポケットモンスター キミにきめた！ Remix
title.romaji: Gekijouban Pocket Monsters: Kimi ni Kimeta! Remix

synonyms: 洗っても洗っても落ちない

title.romaji: Dame na Tokoro ga Sukidatta no Kamo

141048.description: Because of some abnormal sunspots, the climate of Earth starts to change to become more arid, and a new species of ant-people appears within humanity. Isn't it the "evolution"? Isn't "natural selection" that ant-people are taking over humans?

141050.description:
The monster was pulled out of the sea by Dr. Frankenstein and given life, but then took the life of its creator and set out alone into the city. This is where the story begins. The monster roams the city, causing terror and destruction. What will be its final fate? In addition to the title story, this book also includes the stories "Yunte", "The Day the Crane Flew" and "Mountain Demon Gongoro."

(Source: Sukima, translated)
synonyms: Kaibutsu no komori-uta Kyoufu no Monster
怪物の子守唄 恐怖のモンスター
日本のおばけシリーズ1 人食い鬼婆
日本のおばけシリーズ1

141053.description:
I didn't think this one sided love would come true. As it is, I wish we could just remain friends. Dokyung wouldn't like it if he knew how I feel about him, so that's the only way.

However, Yoon Jae, who has been in one sided love with Do-kyung, is shaken by the appearance of Kyung-won who...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

141054.description:
One day, a circus troupe came across the street from Eden's school. Passing by the barracks, Eden meets the ring master of the troupe, Luke. Eden, who feels guilty for Luke for a certain childhood incident, recognizes him at one glance. However, Luke does not recognize him, and Eden felt upset leads him to getting drunk at the circus welcome party. The two accidentally spend a passionate night and quickly become close. Enamoured by Eden's cute and unguarded natural, Luke, who has lived a prosperous and carefree life so far, can't stop himself from falling for him. Eden is also attracted to Luke, who has grown up to be serious and cool, unlike when his young self, but the rumours about him being a Casanova leave him uneasy.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

141058.description:
Heo Gyun came from 400 years ago to our present time. He met Heo Eun-Sil who was poor and have many debts to pay. Together, they ran a Korean traditional dish/style restaurant. Could they successfully run the restaurant?

(Source: Kakao Indonesia, translated)

141059.description:
Georgia 2066, in a world overrun by a zombie epidemic, Ryu Kai has always admired Croix. He thought that their paths would never cross, but suddenly he is assigned a mission with him !! The implications will be more than unexpected….

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

141060.description: A complicated love triangle between a boy, his mother and his mother’s young lover.

141061.description:
Bengoshi no Kuzu is about Takeda Masami, a new lawyer and fellow lawyer Kuzu Motohito, who Takeda is teamed up with, and how they deal with different court cases.

Bengoshi no Kuzu received the Shogakukan Manga Award for seinen/general category in 2007.

141064.description:
My college classmate, Lynn, has long black hair, an elegant face, and a mature air about her.
One day, she sat in front of me in a lecture, her legs stretched out from her tight skirt, and wiggled her feet, as if to show them off to me.

(Source: Rakuraku Shupan, translated)

141065.description:
Twin girls, Hanako and Mimiko, their father, a formerly care-free manga artist, and their mother, who has a poisonous tongue, lead a tumultuous life.
A slightly surreal and mostly happy kind of parenting manga drawn by Hajime Yamano based on his own experiences.

141066.description:
Father Lucas seems to attract misfortune wherever he goes. It all started with the fire that took his parents' lives. Since then, he has met numerous pickpockets and swindlers. And now? He has stumbled upon a badly injured man, unconscious in the middle of the woods! Lucas, alarmed, brings the man to the nearest church to tend to his wounds. By some miracle, the man wakes up soon after and seems almost completely recovered, even though the doctor said he might be out for another three days. Just who is this beautifully invincible man!? Has Lucas attracted yet another calamity...?

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: スウィーティーアガペー

141067.description:
It is a story about Bobo, a man with a cross star on his forehead, and his friends' epic journey and adventure to build an ideal country.

(Source: Sukima, translated)

141070.description:
A collection of stories.
Each story highlights, without hypocrisy, man's meanness towards those who are "different". Cursed stories of genetic mutations, where metamorphoses, painful and gruesome, become an act of purification towards a society that repudiates every "abnormality".

1. Seikimatsu Bansankai (世紀末晩餐会)
2. Tsuuya (通夜)
3. Mou Hitotsu no Kao (もう一つの顔)
4. Boku no Mimi ha Zou no Mimi (僕の耳は象の耳)
5. Mangetsu no Mushiotoko (満月の蟲男)
6. Akai Me no Nezumi (赤い目の鼠)
7. Shitai to Kurasu Otoko (死体と暮らす男)
8. Splatterman (スプラッターマン)

141071.description: Aya Hanamura is a perfect student at an all-girls school. One day, a voice calls out to her and puts her in a trance. She doesn't remember that she received a crystal ball from an old lady. Now every night, Aya has nightmares where she is in a trance-like state, walking to a feudal castle to get her blood sucked by the vampire samurai nobleman.

141074.description:
Yan Qinghe, an emperor teacher, was struck by lightning and was transmigrated to a modern studio as an actor. Thanks to his previous experience as a national teacher, he gets to play his ancient self in the movie. And, to his surprise, his co-star just happens to be the reincarnated king...

(Source: INKR)

141075.description:
As the climate gets warmer, the ice sheet in the Arctic Ocean is slowly melting, and the ancient virus that laid dormant for billions of years in the permafrost of Siberia is gradually awakening... Facing two young men from the distant past with advanced technology, the life of the ordinary girl Liu Zitian is about to get very exciting...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

141076.description:
A scout in the infamous Demon Cult, Seol-Hwi is on a routine patrol when his squad unexpectedly encounters a fearsome master of the Mount Hua Sect, the sworn enemies of the Demon Cult. Without warning, the Mount Hua Cult master slaughters the entire squad. As Seol-Hwi lies dying, lamenting years of service to the cult with nothing to show for it, he is suddenly faced with a video game prompt, asking if he would like to start again. Given the opportunity to start over and make different choices, Seol-Hwi vows to survive and become stronger so he can rise to the top of the Demon Cult.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
synonyms: เส้นทางสู่เทพมาร

141077.description: After the Raccoon City incident, Claire is still searching her brother, Chris. Her actions cause her to be captured by Umbrella and taken to a strange place called Rockfort Island. Infested with zombies, Clairetries to escape, and is helped by Steve Burnside, a young man imprisoned on the island as well.

141078.description:
"I came to get plastic surgery."
"I refuse."
The world's first plastic surgeon refusing to do plastic surgery?!
Plastic surgeon Jin-Su, is a fanboy of idol Ju-Ho who owns the "perfect face". One day someone with the same face as Ju-Ho comes to the plastic surgery clinic?! But it isn't Ju-Ho, but his twin brother Min-Ho? Jin-Su who is caught between the twin brothers! What does the future hold for him?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)
synonyms: Meeting Your Ideal Type at the Plastic Surgeon

141079.description: Note: First published Garo 1968-09, later reworked in an 1973 issue of COM

title.native: 底辺冒険者だけど魔法を極めてみることにした ～無能スキルから神スキルに進化した【魔法創造】と【アイテム作成】で無双する～
title.romaji: Teihen Boukensha Dakedo Mahou wo Kiwamete Miru Koto ni Shita: Munou Skill kara Kami Skill ni Shinka Shita "Mahou Souzou" to "Item Sakusei" de Musou Suru

141082.description:
"Then, go ahead and die."

Capsodia the Death Scorpion (Level 1) was called the "weakest" and was chased out of his position as one of the Four Heavenly Monarchs in the Demon Lord's Army. He was planning to hide out in the Human's Territory until things die down a bit, but he became idolized by Pafimia, an animal-eared Heroine, and Sharon, a pint-sized Saint...

Introducing an astounding fantasy story chock full of excitement!!

(Source: Seiga Nicovideo, translated)

141083.description: The mask of Hannya, a jealous she-devil located in an old antique store, scrutinizes the darkness of men's hearts and knows the secrets of all the objects that have been accumulating there since time immemorial. Prepare well because certain death comes at odd times, and whether you are a young man or a tired old man, whatever she finds you, she will take you with her to hell.

After becoming lost on a snowy mountain, Mosaku and Minokichi, a father and son, are forced to spend the night in a mountain hut. After the two fell asleep for a while, Minokichi woke up from the cold to find a snow-woman hovering over his father... It is the start of a supernatural night. Contains the title story and five other short stories.

(Source: Sukima, translated)

141090.description: A beast tamer without a familiar, Lock had been supporting his friends in an S Rank party until they finally decided to use him as a decoy and abandoned him. After a conversation with the Fenrir his party was attacking, it chose to serve him as his familiar. By using and expanding the [Mini Monster Garden], Lock gathers more and more familiars to form the strongest- and cutest- party ever. Behold, a fantasy where men and beasts go on adventures together.

Why does Michitake Icho feel like a loser? Well, he’s a Todai (Tokyo University) graduate, but he’s got nothing to show for it except a part-time job where everyone treats him like dirt. One day, he turns on the TV to discover the crush of his life, Hayase Yuki, is getting married! After a tragic bike accident, Icho suddenly leaps seven years back in time to the beginning of his college days. What could go wrong?

The two of us are just sex friends... but the truth is... I'm actually in love with him(her)! Oblivious to each other's feelings, what does the future hold in store for these lovebirds?

141096.description:
My stepbrother, Akira, was introduced to me as a high school student when our parents remarried. He is a beautiful boy but shy because he grew up in a difficult family environment. I've always wanted brother, so I spent time with Akira for his sake, and...... we hit it off right away, and we quickly grew close!

I asked him, "......bro, do you like me?" "Yes, of course."

Our relationship deepened despite a critical misunderstanding. Until finally, I realized that Akira was actually my "sister" and I became very confused.......

"I liked the relationship between us when we were just brothers. But I wish we could be something more than that."

Akira's new approach, trying to make us "lovers" instead of "siblings," has begun!
A flirtatious love comedy with an easy-going, too-cute, little-brother-like sister!

(Source: Fantasia Bunko, translated)

title.native: じつは義妹でした。 ～最近できた義理の弟の距離感がやたら近いわけ～

141097.description: Written by Leiji Matsumoto in 1953, before his debut as a professional mangaka, and published by Mandarake in 1998, Boukenki's the author's first approach to the pirate genre. The protagonist, Captain Kingston, is Captain Harlock's first prototype.

141099.description:
Masato Kazama is 26 years old. He is a salaryman working at a high pressure company... an advertising agency. He is what you would call a "corporate drone."

Masato's junior, the new-graduated employee Nagisa Inami, is the perfect heroine.
She is beautiful, stylish, and is quick to learn her job. In addition, she is friendly and sociable.
If there is one drawback to Nagisa, it is that she likes her trainer, Masato, a little too much.

"Hehehe~ I can give him a kiss whenever he compliments me, right?"
"Let's go for a drink today, senpai!"
"That's right. Let's go have a drink today, too! You say you can't drink with a pretty junior?"

She always invites me out for drinks after work, and when she gets drunk, she becomes a spoiled brat.

"If we miss the last train, let's just go to a hotel! I'm sure you know what that means............." What?

Is it because she loves to drink, or because she has trouble getting home, or is it just youthful indiscretion?
Or could it be......?

(Source: Fantasia Bunko, translated)

title.native: かまって新卒ちゃんが毎回誘ってくる ねえ先輩、仕事も恋も教育してもらっていいですか？

Boku no Hero Academia - Vol. World Heroes

141102.description:
When Lin Yue was transported to the Hong Meng Continent, he was forced to live the same day for 100,000 years. No matter how much he struggled, he would still return to the same day at sunrise. In a hundred millennia, Lin Yue learned everything there was to know about the world, unlocking the secrets of countless mighty warriors from numerous sects.Gradually, he had to accept the fact that he would never escape his endless loop of reincarnation.However, on the final day of the 100,000th year, Lin Yue snatched away the Seven Demons Emperor’s fiancée and chopped off the arm of a sect elder’s son. After stirring up such a catastrophe, he suddenly found that a brand-new day had opened its doors for him…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

141103.description:
Game designer Zhou Yuzai suddenly died while working overtime and transmigrated into the cultivation game he was working on. He became the main antagonist Wei Buwang, who had killed the female lead Jiang Yunbo's entire family. Zhou Yuzai thought he would have it easy in his own game, but Jiang Yunbo's tendency to die in game also reset him back to the start, too. It turned out that even though he was a powerful demon lord, he was still just an NPC compared to the actual main character Jiang Yunbo. So he decided to help Jiang Yunbo get stronger instead, and pick up his own harem along the way!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

141104.description:
Super cute sister and brother got transported to the magic world to save mankind?!
Down in the depths of the parallel world outside of Earth, there were twelve magic seals sealing away ancient demons. One day, the twelve magic fairies guarding the seals were trapped and badly hurt by the evil vassal king. The king even cursed the fairies and turned them into babies with hardly any magic. Only by finding twelve children selected by fate could the fairies regain their powers and save the world. The story begins here...

(Source: Webcomics, edited)
synonyms: It Takes a Lot of Cuteness to Save This World
キュートな魔仙たちは世界を救う

141105.description:
Haegeum's fiancé offers her an outrageous proposal... he wants them to each have one last steamy fling with other people before getting married. After her initial heartbreak and shock, she agrees, but for only one reason—revenge! She wants him to regret this selfish decision, and the best way to accomplish that is with a younger, sexier boyfriend. Luckily, the perfect guy just moved in next door. Sihoon is accomplished, handsome, and charming... but he's her younger brother's best friend. Can Haegeum get her revenge AND keep the guy?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: รักหลอกๆ ใจบอกว่าใช่

141106.description:
Milky Way Village is a charming, rustic town where the Milky Way galaxy illuminates the night sky. At its heart stands Night Compass, a cozy doll shop run by Baek Young-ha and his family. While Young-ha is passionate about creating and repairing dolls, his skills aren’t as refined as his parents’. Still, he’s determined not to let that stop him from pursuing his dream of sharing the joy of handmade dolls with the world - starting with his own community. Welcome to the Milky Way High Doll Club, where Young-ha and his friends navigate the rough patches of youth, one stitch at a time!

(Source: Lezhin US)

141107.description:
Ever since he was young, "Woojong Kim" adored cute and pretty things, and believed that once he became an adult, he too would become like the idols he watched on TV.

Instead, he becomes a 195 centimeter, heavily muscled, masculine man. Timid Woojong thus decides to create beauty instead, and changes his plans accordingly. This is how he meets "Ryuhyun", who studies modeling in the same university.

It's love at first sight for Woojong, who then asks Ryuhyun to become his model. Ryuhyun, who has secrets that stop him from loving himself, accepts Woojong's offer with a condition attached.

A story of how brawny yet adorable Woojong meets the gloomy yet beautiful Ryuhyun and helps him get over his past.

(Source: Copin Comics)

141111.description:
In a magical world where lady knights can grow dicks and live happily ever after with their beloved princesses, young mage Chrome is busy studying under her busty mistress, but she just keeps messing up! First she turns the queen's lilies into monsters, then she ventures into a forbidden cellar filled with even stranger plants. The plants make Chrome grow a thick, meaty "stamen" of her own. When her master returns, she'll have to dole out some strict punishment to her wayward pupil complete with binding tentacle vines and her own beefy futanari cock!

(Source: FAKKU)

141112.description:
Clara is publicly a loyal king in the employ of princess Fleur, but secretly she’s in love with her Lady. In six months, Fleur is poised to marry a foreign prince, which drives Clara to her wit’s end. A shady court mage makes her drink a potion that will make her “more honest”, but too late does she realize it’ll also make her grow a splendid cock.

Now equipped with means to make love to her princess, Clara makes a move...

Being the new kid at school is tough. Bayul’s a target for gossip, arrogant bullies, and strict teachers… and he’s also burdened with being the son of a famed war hero and dealing with a chronic illness. Life just isn’t easy for him at Carringston Academy, but luckily, he has a few steadfast friends watching his back! He’ll need them and all the help he can get as he learns that his late mother’s pendant may lead to a power and a past he never knew he had. Can this be the path to a destiny greater than he could have ever imagined?

(Source: Tapas)

141119.description:
One day, a near-death experience causes Loelline Deaz to remember her past life, awakening the power to see the future through her dreams. However, there is one vision in particular that weighs on her the most-- she foresees the murder of the empire’s hero, Duke Dante Van Benerit! Loelline is the only one who can save the duke, but as she gets closer to uncovering the conspiracy behind his demise, she realizes that her past may have more to do with the grim future than she could’ve ever dreamed…

(Source: Tapas)

サムライ拳 The Star Road

141121.description:
Just when her crush was about to express his feelings for her, our FL is warped away into the world of an unknown webnovel. Stuck as a noble lady with a suspicious suitor who wants her life, and a mystery savior who looks a little too familiar... Death-threats, protective MLs, and a dark secret that surrounds the FL's new life! I don't care anymore! Take me back home!

141124.description:
A bravely blunt autobiography about confronting the tangled traumas of gender dysphoria and workplace sexual harassment.

Nonbinary manga artist Poppy Pesuyama is excited when forms offer the option to choose "neither" for gender and thrilled about their new job working as an assistant for mangaka X! But then he sexually harasses them, treating them first like a girl and then like something less than human. It only lasts a few months, but in some ways it never ends.

Born into a body they hate and still reeling from the abuse they faced seven years ago, Pesuyama begins to rail at their past, their friends, and even their mother as they try to come to terms with who they are and what happened to them.

(Source: VIZ Media)

From that day onwards, the Duke's daughter, Louise, works hard to make her fiancé Alphonse hate her.

China,221 BCE. Under the tyranny of the First Emperor,the people suffered from heavy taxes. Great men with ambition rise to overthrow the Qin Empire! And Liu Bang,who later establishes the "Han",spends his carefree days in a rural city in Pei County,unaware of his own destiny.

141139.description:
Ako and Hiro were always together. Ako was so sure that Hiro reciprocated her feelings, but after he rejected her, it left a deep scar in her heart. Ten years have passed since then. Ako decides she needs to spread her wings and forget all about what happened. Right when she's having trouble convincing her dad to let her move out on her own, someone comes to the door. It turns out to be Hiro, her first love, and they haven't seen each other since the rejection. But, since Ako's parents trust him a lot, they let her move into his apartment building. Ako is thrilled to be on her own, but when she forgets to call the gas company, she's forced to ask Hiro for help and close the distance between them. Ako wants to reset the bittersweet memories of her first love and try her relationship with Hiro again.

(Source: Renta!)

141140.description:
Liu Quanyou’s father was an exorcist from a small mountain village who got into some trouble when he was dealing with a spirit. Combining that with his grandfather owing a blood debt when he was young, Liu Quanyou had been cursed by a spirit since he was a kid. He would not be able to live past 23. Not wanting to let his child walk down this path, his father started to teach him some exorcism techniques. Since Liu Quanyou had the natural ability to see spirits, a lot of talent, and had inherited a special scroll from his father, the fox deity grandpa that died saving him left him with his granddaughter, Qianqian. She was to become his fiancée, being raised along with him and was given the new name, Liu Jie. The fox demon Liu Jie was powerful, she followed Liu Quanyu, who managed to get into a university, to the city and begin their path of exorcism. At the same time, they had to find a way to break his curse, they only had three years left.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Fang Ziyu, a BL comic artist, was looking for reference material for his next work. He found inspiration in an art student Nan Gongzhi who became his model. They became drawn to each other in the process, but both have secrets they can't tell. Will they be able to help each other...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

141143.description:
...I love molding them. ♪

In the corrupt city of Sin-si, Zeha suddenly wakes up in a hospital, unable to recall anything that happened after speaking with a mysterious man one night. He soon learns that strange beings called beom are wreaking havoc on the city. As destiny brings seven boys together, will they succeed in ending this fight, once and for all? Let the hunting begin!.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

141145.description:
It’s the age of magic; a world where magic idols prevail. In these extraordinary times, an ordinary idol group called Star One is suddenly gifted with magical powers. And with these magical powers, a mysterious enemy appears. The once unpopular idol group finds themselves tasked with saving the world. Will they be able to take on this enormous responsibility to restore peace?

(Source: WEBTOON)

141146.description:
Welcome to Riverfield, where the most popular boys at two rival schools happen to be vampires and werewolves. When a mysterious new student, Sooha, transfers to Riverfield, the rivals find themselves inexplicably drawn to her. As horrible incidents start to shake the town, the boys’ forgotten pasts slowly start to unravel… and their world turns upside down.

(Source: WEBTOON)

141147.description:
Li Fei, who had to find "work" because his mother was seriously ill, somehow caught the eye of a rich big-boss. Not only did he have to help the boss-man with work, but also to accompany him to dine and entertain? Li Fei thought he was just a mean boss who liked to tease, and he found it hard to handle, even as he was charmed by the man. But then Li Fei discovered that his boss was actually the Devil himself...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: The Way to Appeal to the Devil

141148.description:
Ilya, the 13th prince of a small kingdom, was born an unexpected—and very much unwanted—omega whose birth brought shame upon his royal family. As the lowest-ranking member and an omega, he is destined for a political marriage meant to improve his kingdom’s standing.

Resigned to his fate, Prince Ilya travels to his new faraway home. Upon entering the king’s gilded palace, where he’s expecting to meet his future husband, he instead finds a mysterious young boy with an unsettling message.

(Source: SuBLime)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

141149.description:
Yota is a high school boy who loves sweets and fried food. His lunch at school usually consists of pastries or fast food. How can he change his unhealthy eating habits!?

After Yota's parents decided on an arranged marriage for him, a hand-made bento box came unexpectedly from his fiancee. When he ate the bento, it tasted better than anything he's ever eaten…

He has never met her, he doesn't even know her name, but his secret relationship with his mysterious fiancee has begun.

(Source: Comic Be, translated)

141151.description:
It is an era where everyone is a cultivator except for Wang Ling. He doesn't care about cultivation, elixirs, and whatnot, yet he shows an aptitude for martial arts. He picks up sword skills at three and attains Godhood at five. Despite his efforts to keep a low profile, he quickly makes a name for himself.

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: The Daily Life of Immortal King

141152.description:
Kaguhara Ririka is a high school girl in her first year at Fu Eichi High School. She has an ordinary appearance, no personality to speak of, and no friends. However, she has a unique hobby that she keeps secret. She loves exploring all kinds of embarrassing "fetishes" of cute girls, and she keeps a diary of her observations of those girls trying to keep their fetishes to themselves! As Ririka seeks out the sweat, smell, and flesh of cute girls and record them writhing in shame, who will be the object of her observation tonight?

(Source: Gamma Plus, translated)

141154.description: Yeon Yoo-Young has been living with his father and sister in the castle of Yongsan in the countryside since his mother was unfairly accused of theft and beaten to death. Tortured and abuse by his family, the young man has become frail and thin, and deemed a mute due to his inability to speak properly. One day, he decides to jump off a coastal cliff and end his life, but instead encounters Crown Prince Jin-Bi Hyul and falls in love at first sight! Yeon Yoo-Young regains his will to live, but his sister soon plots to win the prince's affection for herself. Jin-Bi Hyul, however, is known for his cruel disposition…

141155.description:
Sung-Yeol loses his mind after stabbing his lover who tried to kill him. It was Ja-Seong who accidentally saved him. Ja-Seong allows Sung-Yeol to stay at his house until the heavy snow stops. That night, Ja-Seong places his hands on Sung-Yeol’s chestnut-like body. Sung-Yeol seduces Ja-Seong by telling the man mysterious stories. Here lies the lives of two men whose kept secrets begin to overlap.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

141157.description:
Killer mermaids, gender swapping, and a devilish little sister with the power to end the world—four more unforgettable short stories that reveal the starting point of Tatsuki Fujimoto, the twisted mastermind behind Chainsaw Man.

But when the game goes live, the elation of the players quickly turns to horror as they discover that, for all its amazing features, SAO is missing one of the most basic functions of any MMORPG—a log-out button. Now trapped in the virtual world of Aincrad, their bodies held captive by NerveGear in the real world, users are issued a chilling ultimatum: conquer all one hundred floors of Aincrad to regain your freedom. But in the warped world of SAO, "game over" means certain death-both virtual and real...

Worse comes to worst when she wanders off set and runs into Ahn, the actor playing Hwi. While Jae-Rin loves Hwi to death, she couldn’t care less about the egomaniacal star bringing him to life. Yet lo and behold, a near-fatal accident transports them into the drama! The once fictional world is now their reality. What no one expects is for Julius to call off the engagement, claiming that Philia’s perfection makes her charmless and unlikable. To add insult to injury, Philia is packed off to a neighboring country in exchange for gold and resources, forcing her to leave her homeland! Despite bracing herself for mistreatment, Philia finds a warm welcome in her new town, where she puts her saintly abilities to good use erecting barriers against monsters and curing epidemics. So now he is going to live with his aunt Alba, who is Spanish and seemed unfriendly at first. A new life begins in a strange country, with family he has never met before!

Her parents disowned her, and she hit rock bottom. However, the day after she stamped their divorce papers, time rewinds back to just before her affair.......? Harumi swears that she won't make the same mistakes again in her new life, but this time, her husband falls into adultery and she becomes the unwanted wife!

When she next opens her eyes, she finds herself standing directly before His Majesty the Emperor. While it seems that Ryouta is no match for the two great goddesses, the truth is that they take great care of him, preparing homemade lunches for him and nursing him during his sleep! At work, the person he acknowledges as his rival in business performance is Houjou Misaki, who is also an alpha.

Kouga has been putting some distance from his alpha supremacist grandfather, the current head of the Nishimiya clan. But one day, on the latter's orders, the family butler, Harada, visited Kouga with a child.

Now, Kouga is struggling to take care of Haruto who to his surprise, turned out to be a really energetic boy. At the same time, Kouga found out that Houjou also sends his child to the same kindergarten that Haruto attends.

Born as the second prince of the Kingdom of Zain, Raidor became the owner of Dahinslave, the "cursed holy sword," one of the twelve holy swords said to exist on earth. Raidor, angered and disgusted by his brother's order, ostensibly obeys, but secretly decides to rebel! The holder of the other holy swords and the betrayal of others nobles come one after another. Yakou Shizuka, a quiet and bashful woman, works at a detective agency. Her boss Tounome owns the company and is the gentlemanly type–kind and dapper–though he also has an unusual trait: he’s invisible! This is perfect for detective work, but he quickly comes to find it doesn’t work on Yakou, who is blind and always knows if he’s near. Charmed, Tounome is determined to get her to date him and isn’t against using his many “skills.” Yakou’s quirky coworkers–a contrarian human man and a sisterly beastwoman–kindly watch over her as she stumbles and blushes through the uncharted waters of office romance.

The person he has a crush on is the playboy who lives across the hall from him in their college dorm, Kouki Shima. Kouki's a heavy smoker who has a new girlfriend every few months and is always being scolded by Yuki. But, the truth is, Yuki's crazy about Kouki. Then, one day, Kouki finds out that Yuki's gay, but not in the way that Yuki wants him to...! This is a pure love story between an aggressive playboy and a masochist dork with glasses.

141464.description: While she's patrolling the ruins of the housing complex where her father died years ago, high-schooler Himeji encounters a young man who claims to be from hell. Yumeji is allowed to return to Earth and work for his atonement, and he is given an ability related to his crimes (in his case, he can cut things with his hands). He can atone for his sins in three ways: by rescuing good people, by defeating bad people, or by killing others who have been released from hell. His wife ran away and followed another man, and his brother was in a conflict with him. When everything seemed to be at its worst, he woke up after being drunk and found himself lying on his bed with a peerless handsome man! And this guy kept sticking with him all day long! 141474.description: During winter vacation, Hideo accompanied his brother Yusuke on a whaling ship to the Southern Ocean. There, they were attacked by a scorpion monster. Hideo launched an electric harpoon to drive off the monster and allowed their ship to escape. A few days later, Dr. Carl Schmidt came from Germany and revealed the true identity of the monster on TV. The monster, named Sasora by the scientists, was a red scorpion modified for military use by Dr. Von Schmidt's brother during World War II. However, just as he was about to carry out his plan, the FBI destroyed his laboratory in the Amazon, and the red scorpion disappeared into the jungle. Dr. Carl speculated that the red scorpion was exposed to radiation from a nuclear test in the Amazon and became a giant. He apologized on behalf of his late brother, but then came the news that Sasora was on its way to Tokyo!

141475.description: Tendou Toramaru was an orphan from a small country defeated during the Warring States period. Having lost his parents in the futile battle, he wished for a world where the common people can live peacefully. Without personal ambition or greed, he served as a strategist to help Oda Nobunaga and Toyotomi Hideyoshi lead their armies to victory, using military science he learned from an early age. After many victories, Toramaru was convinced that Hideyoshi will successfully reunite the entire country. So he left the camp to help those who had lost their parents and family members to recover from the war. After that, it was said that Toramaru was an active advisor in the Korean campaign by Hideyoshi's wish.

He fought in the service of his friend, Emperor Caesar Van Briton, but it is all for naught when his fearful comrades try to kill him. He’s on the brink of death when his trusty weapon, Lukia, shines and propels him back to the stables of his childhood. With his mighty spear in hand, Joshua is dead set on revenge in this life!

When career-minded Kentaro Hiyama finds out that he’s pregnant, it will change the course of more than just his own life. In the Japan of Eri Sakai’s thought experiment, ten years have passed since the male sex has spontaneously gained the ability to get pregnant, and society has struggled to adjust. Kentaro isn’t sure at first who the mother might be, and quickly finds himself butting up against regressive attitudes and discriminatory policies—most of which long precede male pregnancy. In his previous life, he’d never given any of it a second thought—he may have even held the same views. But through his encounters with other pregnant people, and galvanized by his new perspective, Kentaro turns his skills in business and marketing to effecting social change.

141517.description: The climactic finals are over, and U.A. is getting ready for the summer training camp. Deku and All Might receive an invitation from a certain person to go overseas to a giant artificial moving city called I-Island. This island, a kind of “science Hollywood” that gathers the knowledge of scientists from around the world, is holding an exhibition called I-Expo showcasing the results of Quirk and hero item research. In the midst of all this, Deku meets a Quirkless girl named Melissa and remembers his own Quirkless past. Out of the blue, the impregnable security system the island boasts is hacked by villains, and all the people on the island are taken as hostages! Now, a plan that could shake hero society has been put into motion! The man who holds the key to it all is the number one hero and Symbol of Peace, All Might.

How does a gold-eating dragon survive in the modern human world? Transform into a human, of course, to earn money! He needed to expand and widen his business empire for him to earn to earn the coveted dragon throne, thus he had no choice but to hire a secretary, and was even willing to sign a contract for the secretary to become the dragon’s knight. From then onward, they will protect each other and fight together. Turns out the secretary is a dragon slayer?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

141519.description:
This is a story of a mystery investigator, Levi, and a flamboyant medium, Laird.

Two people have disappeared in this ordinary town. They were seen entering a 'door' that sudden appeared only to disappear along with that 'door'. To find the missing, investigator Levi and self-proclaimed psychic, exorcist, explorer, and mystery researcher Laird decide to enter this 'door' together and investigate the truth behind it all.

Laird, "And here I thought mean and aloof people like you don't understand what a 'warm hug' is!"
Levi, "Why? Is this not warm enough for you? It's not that difficult."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

141520.description:
When he opened his eyes one day, Yuyu found that he had entered a strange game world filled with monsters, and if you die, your death is broadcast live. To survive, you must beat the game. Fortunately, Yuyu meets the game's cold-mannered god, Yunze. Caring more about his life than his image, Yuyu clings to Yunze for help.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

141521.description: The aspiring heroes of UA Class 1-A have been given a new training opportunity during their winter break: To establish and maintain their own professional Hero Agency on the idyllic island of Nabu far off the coast of Japan. There, they'll experience the everyday travails of being heroes, for the first time without the support of their instructors or chaperons. It's a challenging assignment, but one the plucky students of UA are more than equipped to face – that is, until the arrival of a team of villains lead by the ruthless Nine and his eerily familiar quirk. Cut off from any backup and facing their greatest threat yet, it's up to Deku, Bakugo, and their classmates to face unspeakable danger to protect not only the people of the island, but the future of all Hero society.

Saki Noze works in the Department of Public Relations at Yayagi University. Though he lacks charisma and general social skills, his colleagues care for him like a loving child. Saki Noze is an anxious and timid person. But he knows all that. What he doesn't know is why this young man in front of him is acting so frantic. Who even is he?! Let's rewind... Saki Noze works in the Department of Public Relations at Yayagi University. His facial expressions are hard to read, he lacks social skills, and he has recently slipped on a leaf which rendered him unconscious. When Saki comes to, he is in a hospital bed with no recollection of the past six months... Aha! So this person must be someone he's met within the past six months! Hm... But still... who is he?

Haruka Nagashima is an OL who had nothing to show for her life despite her hard work. She was caught in a marriage scam and lost her savings, and at the same time she made a terrible mistake at work. Just when she thought she was about to lose her job, the president's daughter, Ichijo Manyo, offered to take care of her? Will she be able to turn her life around? Or will she fall into a bottomless pit of despair? With their differences and secrets, they begin a turbulent life together!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

After being dumped by her boyfriend, Koyori went to her longtime friend Hijiri's house to drink away her sorrow...and ended up spending the night with him! Not only that, he tells her he loves her—and she's not sure how to reconcile the new development with someone she's known since they were kids. After all, the stakes are high—if things don't work out, she'll hurt one of her closest friends. And to make matters worse, her ex wants to patch things up...? Koyori needs to figure out what she wants, before she loses it all.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

141532.description:
1. Toy's Time
After being drunkenly dared to go to the adult toy store to buy whatever the worker recommends, Takao finds himself in a heart-racingly risky situation! The attractive store owner is a bit too enthusiastic about his merchandise...

2. The Lover Next Door
Mitsuru and his lover, Hitoshi, go at it all the time and forget about the paper-thin walls barely separating them from the resident next door. After coincidentally leaving Hitoshi's apartment at the same time as his neighbor, Mitsuru hears something that would never be heard between two friendly neighbors making small talk: "You're faking feeling good, aren't you?"

3. The Passing Summer
In a small town where the hustling bustling life of Tokyo-ites is a foreign concept, a mysterious man from Tokyo buys a house. Shimpei visits the house and gets caught staring at the beautiful man sitting in the doorway...

4. After School
The student council president is perfect. He is calm, cool, and collected. Everybody admires him, wants to do work for him, and hopes to serve him. But the student council president is a people pleaser. He wants to do the work. He wants to serve others and make people happy. Will anybody ever hear his silent plea!?

(Source: Futekiya)

Official parody manga about the anime series Shuumatsu no Izetta. The name is a pun, as 終末(end) and 週末(weekend) can both be read a "shuumatsu".

141535.description: To eat or be eaten, such is the way to live by relying on others. Kokonoe, a forest-dwelling fox, chanced upon a baby hawk that fell from his nest. He took the fledgling home as fodder, but Kokonoe ultimately couldn't bring himself to eat him, not after the child came to love him so wholeheartedly. So with that, Kokonoe named him "Yosuga" and decided to become his parent. "Please eat me." Now an adult, Yosuga always demands this of Kokonoe, wanting to repay Kokonoe for raising him so lovingly. But in response, Kokonoe starts feeling a different kind of "hunger" towards Yosuga...? "If only I could bear Kokonoe's children..."

141536.description:
The elegant warrior, Mylene, has a secret—inside her lurks the soul of the strongest mercenary in history, Savage Fang. This former sellsword will use her past experience and newfound powers to shape the world as she sees fit.

141538.description:
A restaurant run by ghosts!

Kazuko is an orphan with big culinary dreams. One day, she inherits a restaurant from a distant relative with one condition: she must live in the accompanying mansion. The catch? It's haunted! With the help of her new ghost friends, Kazuko works toward her dreams and discovers the meaning of family.

(Source: Manta)

141540.description:
"I would never tell anyone. What I really like, that is." Ann Kobayashi, an eighth-grade girl living in a provincial city who partakes in a basketball club, has a hypersensitive and self-conscious preference for gathering tragic and memorable newspaper articles about murders, suicides, and accidents involving mass deaths, and is fascinated by photo collections of decadent dolls. One day, Ann witnesses the bizarre behaviour of her classmate, a boy named Tokugawa. Bringing the attention-grabbing work that depicts the suffocating realism of adolescence's unique sense of stagnation!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

141541.description:
"Fortune and Misfortune are two sides of the same coin?! Reverse any adversary and cease redemption!!"

Siegbert is reborn after an unfortunate accident in his previous life. His new family is warm and welcoming... so much so it seems as though he may no longer be an unlucky person. In this world, he can finally live a quiet, peaceful life... or so he thought. It seems that he actually holds an insanely high luck stat in this new world...?

"Every chance is a manifestation of good fortune. If you can cease the chances, your wishes shall be granted..." Conquering each "chance" granted by his good fortune, will he now cease redemption on the generational legacy this family has yet to fulfill?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

141542.description:
Mamoru Kagemori is a high school student who is neither good-looking, studious nor athletic. However, he is actually a skilled ninja who secretly protects his neighbour, Yuuna Konnyaku.

Mamoru and Yuuna are now third year students, but their peaceful times are suddenly interrupted on the day of the opening ceremony when Marimo, a girl who claims to be Mamoru's younger sister, transfers to his school. Marimo immediately issues a challenge to Mamoru, intending to take his duty of protecting Yuuna away from him!

A new chapter of the popular ninja romantic comedy has started!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

141543.description:
"How about we become 'hug buddies'?"
One day on her day off, Chisa coincidentally runs into her boyfriend...holding hands with another woman?! Worse yet, the notorious playboy from her school, Izumi Toudou, also witnesses her crying after the incident. The following day, he keeps pestering her to get her attention, but she ignores his attempts to do so. However, when he moves close to her ear and says, "Should I help you forget about your Ex?" and proposes being "hug buddies," she's unsure how she should react! "You're actually feeling lonely, right?" Chisa tries to act strong, but Toudou's gentle hugs and kindness slowly seeps into her heart. Check out this sweet and heart-throbbing romance that begins through an unusual relationship!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

However, the other saints refused my ascension due to my karma after much slaughter, and I fell, just like that.

When I woke up, I was 60 years in the future. I was reborn as the second lord of the Namgung family: Namgung Hyuk. Where has all the internal energy that I’ve accumulated gone?! Moreover, I have the Nine yin energy blockage?

Leo owes a lot to number one host and owner of the host club Aoi for taking him in and giving him a job when he just arrived in Tokyo. Not only that, but he has feelings for Aoi... Hoping Aoi would someday pop his cherry, Leo does his best to be Aoi's right-hand man, making sure he's the number two host each month. Then, one day, Aoi tells Leo's rival host Taiga that he can have his way with Leo in the bedroom if he beats Leo's profits... and Taiga does!!

141557.description:
The world which was ruled by those called the descendants of god and had unique abilities: Heuk's (Black) clan and Sahwa's clans.

One day, Heuk's clan was destroyed by one of the average human clans, the Parang (Blue) clan. The Sahwa clan sends their heir, Ga-Yeon, as bride to the Parang clan's heir as a sign of obedience.

But the one who's actually sent is the heir's twin brother, Ja-Yeon. Now, Ja-Yeon lives amongst the Parang clan....

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)

141559.description: Due to certain circumstances, office worker Hajime ends up working part-time on an adult film set. After making a mistake that ruins the film, he gets put into debt! He's saved from this predicament by the number one actor Yuu, who suggests that he pay back his debt by appearing in a gay adult film. With no other choice, Hajime accepts the conditions, and takes a test in order to appear in an adult film!

title.native: 素人なのにハメられました

141560.description:
Ryou and Zen are two men who hate to lose–especially to each other. From high school rivals to rival co-workers, these two men have always been locked in fierce competition. They’ve competed over grades, sports, and even the number of Valentine’s chocolates received! And now that they’re salesmen at the same company, their rivalry has reignited.One night, while out for drinks, the two begin arguing about who’s more experienced in love. Suddenly, their newest competition is set: the winner is whoever makes the other fall in love with them first! But will this competition of hearts really lead to a win or something far more complicated?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

141562.description:
Melia, a former office worker, was reborn in another world by chance. She was always working in her previous life, so now she wants to live leisurely in her new world. God grants her wish by making her younger and giving her the blacksmithing skills she had always longed for. Melia was excited to be able to blacksmith every day and enjoy her new life. But it turns out that in this new world, her blacksmithing skills are pretty special. It seems like her quiet days were not meant to be...

(Source: Alpha Manga)

Chan-U finds it difficult talking to Seol-Hui, who always seems to be angry about something. However, what he says to her actually makes her heart beat like crazy! A sweet, romantic story of a young couple's first love!

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

141564.description: Two women meet at a blind-date mixer and somehow ended up as a couple.

141565.description:
It's only been a week since they got married, and they've only just begun their life together. The wife is so perfect in every way, that it makes her husband want to tease her and see her trip up, just a little bit......? A sweet couple's love comedy from Akiba Ruiki!

In a crowded train, strangers are likely to end up being too close for comfort. But for some people, being too close is a comfort. When a poor conductor witnesses the bizarre yet inviting ritual of anonymous train sex, he jumps on the opportunity to turn it into a business. Every night after the midnight train ends its route, he turns it into a rolling bordello. Get ready to climb aboard... the sleazy train is coming.

(Source: Anime News Network)

141567.description:
In Tokyo's Asakusa district there is a shoemaker named Anri, who wears a prosthetic leg and runs her own shop. People with various troubles come to her, such as a high school boy who want to wear heels and a widow trying to let go of her cherished shoes.

Through the shoes she creates, Anri touches the lives of those who have walked their own paths. Her shoes become the power that helps them take a step forward into tomorrow.

This is the heartwarming tale of a shoemaker, where people are connected through a single pair of shoes.

141568.description:
This story describes the lives of gods and monsters living together. There are two Masters and three Disciples living together on Mount Nirvana. Master Guan, who is sometimes a man and sometimes a woman; Master Tang, who is plagued by strange thoughts; Sun Wu, an incredibly handsome chap; Bai, a naughty and outgoing girl; and Yi, a soft and gentle lad. The story is set in the small town of Tao Hua and is centered around the never-changing laws of nirvana and rebirth.

(Sourcce: Webcomics)

This volume contains "Kiiroi Namida: Fuuten - Seishun Zangoku Monogatari"

141570.description:
Wu Xunmei and Xuan Jihua were the leaders of two enemy clans. They were brought together by fate and became lovers. However, caught up by the hatred between their clans, Wu Xunmei was forced to kill Xuan Jihua. Unexpectedly, Xuan Jihua was reborn. In this lifetime, can their love bloom again?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

141571.description:
"An Alpha being in love with another Alpha is taboo!", "Perverts", "You sick people!"...That's what people would say if they knew about the relationship between Ji Wang, a self-restrained Alpha actor, and Qi Boyan, a flamboyant actor and singer, who claims to be an Omega but secretly loves to dominate other Alphas. A mishap tore their relationship apart six years ago. But when fate puts them together again as co-stars in a popular movie, they are forced to face the burning temptation while resolving their past misunderstandings...

(Source: INKR, edited)

141572.description: Haruka and Takumi had their bodies swapped when they fell down a staircase at a shrine. After several years of searching for a way to go back to normal, they find themselves increasingly aware of each other as their physical sex…

141573.description:
Kotobuki-san, a temporary housekeeper, arrives at the fourth-grader Takuto's house. She is supposed to be here for only five days to take care of Takuto and his sister, who is in the second grade, while their parents are away on a trip. At first the atmosphere is friendly, but gradually strange things begin to happen: Kotobuki-san sets mysterious rules, a neighbor's dog goes missing, and the younger sister falls down the stairs. Takuto becomes suspicious and begins to investigate Kotobuki's true identity.

(Source: Sukima, translated)

141574.description:
Masaru Mochizuki is a college student who loves video games. He thought it was going to be fun when the cute JS Yuri moved in next door, but she turned out to be an annoying little brat...?

(Source: Heros Web, translated)

He Qinian and Sheng Xinghe were part of the high jump team at T College. Together, they advanced from the school team to the national team and found fame and success.

What do I do when the boy I practically raised starts coming on to me?! Wait! Hold on! I've always treated you like a brother, and yet you want to seduce me?!

(Source: Huoxing Dongman, translated)

141577.description: A story starting with a sheet of test paper. A special love between two best friends. But even an ordinary couple's love affair could run into obstacles, much less these two.

141578.description:
A sweet and seductive demon x angel couple! The two races were meant to be like fire and water, yet the head general of the demons, Wei Zou, secretly holds a crush on the head general of the angels, An Si. To earn the angel's affection, Wei Zou will try everything to trick the naive angel to come closer to him. In the process, An Si, who disliked demons, started to find himself gradually warming up to Wei Zou.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Chapter count Includes a prologue.

141579.description:
Julianne is as close to perfect as it gets: she’s got looks, talent, and smarts. The only problem is she has terrible taste in men! That’s why her little sister Lilianne is doing everything she can to make sure she doesn’t end up with the wrong guy. However, Julianne’s suitors are quickly catching on that the way to her heart is through Lilianne’s sweet tooth! How far will Lilianne go to set her sister up with the right man? Who will be the sweetest suitor?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

141581.description:
Our protagonist embarks on a journey from a humble mountain village, accompanied by two companions: a strategist and a groom. His goal is to transform the village into the strongest mountain stronghold. He arrives in a chaotic world where he inherits a dilapidated mountain fortress. In the face of this tumultuous and deadly environment, he faces a critical choice: Will he resort to robbing money, food, and women to become a carefree king of the mountain? Or will he pour his heart and soul into battling the heroes of the world, striving to earn a name that will echo throughout the universe? Is anyone truly born destined to be a king, duke, general, or minister?

(Source: Webnovel)

Men running in the desert. They seem to be chasing one girl... This one-shot invites you to an enchanting desert.

The story of Gundam F91 revolves around teenage space colonist Seabook Arno, his girlfriend Cecily Fairchild, and the efforts of the Crossbone Vanguard militia, led by Cecily's grandfather Meitzer Ronah, to establish an aristocracy known as "Cosmo Babylonia". In keeping with Gundam tradition, the civilian Seabook is forced by circumstance to pilot the F91 Gundam, coincidentally designed in part by his estranged mother, Dr. Monica Arno.

(Source: Gundam Wikia)

In her past life, she thought making Leon emperor was the only way to ensure his safety. But if she had known Leon had never wanted the crown, or that laying a crown soaked with the blood of his enemies and beloved ones at his feet would mean he would take his own life before her eyes, she would’ve found another way. In this life, Ellisa is determined to find a way that will ensure both Leon’s survival and happiness. This time, things will be different.

(Source: Tappytoon)

300 years ago, Saintess Maria was murdered for her magical powers, while her loyal knight, Avelron, was powerless to save her. But now, Maria has been reborn as a bright and happy young woman named Yeriel Hyem. Unaware of her true identity as a saintess, Yeriel is living a peaceful life with her beloved parents and younger brother. Things only seem to be looking up when she meets an enigmatic – and extremely handsome – man named Levnaor. But with his arrival comes mysterious events that Yeriel never expected… As things begin to unfold, can Yeriel continue to live her blissful life? Or will her tragic past come back to haunt her once-bright future?

(Source: Tappytoon)

141618.description:

(Source: POCKET COMICS, edited)

141619.description:
So-Ru is a princess born from illegitimacy, and able to see ghosts although she is completely blind. Ja-Hyeon is a heroic general who possesses the sun’s aura which can chase away spirits. Ya-To is the deadliest and most beautiful ghost, but his heart can’t feel anything. So-Ru and Ja-Hyeon become bound to one another in an undesired marriage, but they both need each other –- she needs his aura, he needs her divine blood. As So-Ru's unconditional sacrifice and love toward Ja-Hyeon slowly melts his frozen heart, the same happens to Ya-To’s emotionless heart. All three have something that they need and want from one another. Could they become the salvation they need for one another?

(Source: WEBTOON)

141620.description:
The dazzling world of show biz is filled with dreams, fame, and fortune. Those who make it to the top easily make over a hundred million a year...

With that in mind, we turn to one young fledgling talent: 15-year-old Haru Madoka. She's just moved to Tokyo, chasing after her dreams, and makes 45,000 yen a month. The days have been passing by without any work coming in, causing her to worry from time to time. But thanks to her knowledge of where to get the lowest-priced groceries, and tight management of her finances, she manages to live by herself in the big city of Tokyo. And so, the newbie entertainer's comedic days of real-life money management in the world of show biz begin!

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

141621.description:
Yvonne Brigejer is an archmage and demidragon, the one human loved by the dragon Roigenkistro. Being a dragon’s soulmate is a great privilege, but it also means that she occasionally becomes cold and heartless, just like a dragon. After Yvonne tries to harm her unborn child in a fit of rage, she makes Roigenkistro promise that he will protect her child and her lover, Jeye. But when Roigenkistro fails to keep that promise and Jeye dies, she decides to end her life as well. Sadly, instead of being reunited with Jeye in the afterlife, Yvonne wakes up in a world where no one remembers that she and Jeye were lovers and Roigenkistro is gone. Will Yvonne be able to overcome her sadness and find out what happened to the man and the dragon she loved?

(Source: Tappytoon)

141630.description:
During the Nara period, a young man named Tsuchimaro, who lives on the outskirts of a village, and a servant girl named Saname fall in love. However, Tsuchimaro is sent to imprisonment during the construction of the Great Buddha and they are separated. Saname, who followed him, became the wife of Kuninaka no Kimimaro, who was in charge of the construction of the Great Buddha. During her imprisonment, Saname was captured and poured into the Great Buddha with hot copper in front of Tsuchimaro, who was watching, and at that moment she shouted "Iara".

Later, in the Kamakura period, Azuchi-Momoyama period, Edo period, and the present day, a man with the face of Kimimaro himself appears, seeking the mystery of the word Iara and searching for the woman.

Note: Volume 3-6 of the collected volumes do not contain the main story of Iara but rather a series of one-shots under the Ishoku Tanpen (異色短編) series

After all, why be saddled with someone she doesn't love when she can make her way to the top by herself? But when her father sets her up with Jun Arata, a young hotshot in his own right and someone who knows about the unrequited love Remi fostered for years, she's thrown for a loop. She rejects him, of course, but somehow he keeps finding his way back into her life. But is he interested in her? Or does he only want to take over her business and leave her in the dust?

He always makes sure he is alone before he enters his stall... So HOW did he not notice his classmate Hijiri Kakurai in the same bathroom until AFTER he had finished? Ikuto, always surrounded by friends, worries that Kakurai will spill his little secret. But not only is Ikuto reassured that Kakurai has no one to spill his beans to, he finds out why they ran into each other on that particular Wednesday afternoon...
