title.romaji: Maishuu Suiyou, Danshi Toire de Matteite

141667.description:
The spin off story about Suburu (the son of Akari and Shinji from Liar Mate) and Mitsuki.

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: พันธะลวงซ่อนรัก ภาคสุบารุกับมิซึกิ
嘘つきな番～その匂い、ナカまで染み込ませて【昴と深月編】

title.english: Liar Mate: Let That Scent Soak Deep Inside ~ Subaru and Mitsuki
title.native: 嘘つきな番～その匂い、ナカまで染み込ませて 昴と深月編
title.romaji: Usotsuki na Tsugai: Sono Nioi, Naka made Shimikomasete - Subaru to Mitsuki Hen

141669.description:
Even though Yuzu Kosaka works at an apparel company, she doesn't feel confident in picking out clothes for herself.
One day, she wandered into a women's clothing store to buy a gift for a friend, when Yuzu's boss, who was so stern at work, stumbled out of the fitting room!
"Will you wear it for me?"
A dress-up love comedy about a boss who loves cute women's clothes and his unfashionable subordinate!

(Source: Qurie, translated)
synonyms: Love and fashion given by my boss

title.native: 着せたい上司と、なれない部下

141670.description:
Top Actor Lu who was knee-deep in bad press was suddenly revealed to be seeing an unknown minor star. This sent shockwaves throughout the entertainment world and thus begin an annual retainer to stay on the hot search charts... As the manager said, "This is an agreement for 3 years! You're not allowed to fall for each other for real!" Three years later, the top actor announces, "Thanks everybody, we're celebrating our third anniversary."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: Destined to Meet on the Trends

141671.description:
The phoenix will return from Nirvana and rise up to you once again, my dear Highness.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

141672.description:
The incomparably beautiful Crown Prince was lost in the streets, when he was taken in and became wedded to a common villager. Rather than returning to the world of political machinations and palace intrigue, he preferred to stay away from those petty concerns. He would rather give up his kingdom, and live a plain life with his lover for the rest of time.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

141673.description:
The manga depicts the everyday lives of shoujo manga artist Yako and her cat-type robot assistant Poko.

(Source: Anime News Network)

141674.description:
Arachnids are spiders that mimic humans and eat them. Their appearance has threatened the survival of mankind. One day, Tsumugi, a lonely boy who loves spiders, meets an Arachnid named Senshou who is interested in him. When the incompatible threads of destiny of the eater and the eaten intertwine, what will be woven together?

A dystopian bromance depicting the symbiotic relationship between a heretical predator who doesn't eat humans and a boy who loves spiders.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

141675.description:
A traffic accident caused two unrelated souls to be bound spiritually. Many years later, the victim, Feng Yi, and the assailant, Chu Jiangye, swapped identities. Can they forgive each other’s mistakes and create a brighter future together…?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

141676.description:
Sim Jae Hee is a vampire who wishes to become human. On the day that his supply of blood packs diminished, vampire hunter Kwon Tae Woon appears before the starving Jae Hee, and offers his blood to him…

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
synonyms: ป่วนหัวใจแวมไพร์ฮันเตอร์

141677.description:
Jeong Hyun and Han Seong were friends, but ended up having a "contract relationship" due to Hyun's confession. Hyun, who has a dream where he breaks up with Sung(Seong), will later find out that it was a prophetic dream...?!

(Source: Ktoon, translated)
synonyms: One Night with a Contract Boyfriend
契約恋愛の彼氏と一夜

141678.description: Xiyuan meets Lin Qi once again. Lin Qi used to take care of him when he was little and left an impression on the younger Xiyuan, who unknowingly made his own mark on the lonely older boy.

141679.description:
Jung Dayeon, a webtoon artist and a cat owner saves a young heir from a dog and the next day suddenly a butler appears at her house, what's more the butler has cat ears and a tail?!

"I am Nyangjji from Planet Nya, a planet far from Earth. I have been ordered to be a servant here for one year."

A hilarious human documentary about cat butlers that appeared out of nowhere.

(Source: Kakao Webtoon, translated)

141680.description:
Chulsu’s crush, Sowon, loves animals. Hoping to impress her after years of pining, he lands a job as a keeper at a local zoo. But when the zoo runs out of money and Sowon gets married, Chulsu hits rock bottom—until he gets a crazy idea. He may have lost the girl, but he won’t lose the zoo! What’s this zookeeper scheming?

(Source: Tapas)

141681.description:
Zu An is your typical flame-war keyboard warrior. But then he was transmigrated into a world of cultivation, where political power is tied to the cultivation level of the temples and dojos. The Emperor of the Dazhou Kingdom is himself one of the most powerful cultivators in the world. Zu An migrated into the body of the despised husband of the princess Chu Chuyan. His reputation was irrevocably ruined when he was found sleeping with his wife's sister on his wedding night. But actually his whole marriage was part of a conspiracy, and the seemingly irrelevant son-in-law was the key piece in the imperial intrigue. See how Zu An will navigate the dangers and come out ahead, with the help of his keyboard!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

141683.description:
"My partner is just a male friend."

So-mang Park wants to have a relationship at least once in her teens. But true love leading to a dreamy romantic marriage is just a crazy delusion that'll never happen. In reality, So-mang Park and the word "date" just don't belong together. Then one day a ray of hope shines upon her. Is this what flirting is? This is a story of a cheerful yet delusional girl's quest for romance.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes an epilogue.
synonyms: สามีทิพย์ของสาวจอมเพ้อ

141684.description:
This is a story about the “weak” defeating the strong.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

141685.description:
What?! A game's pets are becoming human and moving into my house one by one?! 17 year old introverted high school student, Zhu Ling, finds no interest in the real world. Until one day, a nude girl appeared before him when he was completing his pet collection in a mobile game! Said girl even proclaimed to be one of the pets in the game and demanded to move in with Zhu Ling and help him collect items! One by one, each pet in his collection turned into pet girls and gathered in his house. Hey! You're all really getting in the way of my gaming time!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.native: 捕获宠物娘的正确方法

141686.description:
Na Hui-Ju, a 19-year-old girl that was bullied at school was reborn as 'Aileen de Sheia', a dragon. She's happy to feel the strong power that no one has experienced and to feel the love and kindness of the people around me for the first time.

As some make their every effort to get ahold of her, some also make their every effort to get rid of her.

(Source: Kakao, translated)
synonyms: หนูน้อยหัวใจมังกร

141687.description:
Tseng Chyi, the most popular escort with a deep understanding of how to please his clients, has got his chance to succeed by approaching a young wealthy man with a bad temper. Thanks to him, friends become enemies, brothers turn against each other, and companies are falling apart... When this game of revenge is about to end with his absolute triumph, the truth suddenly revealed turns his whole world upside down...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

141688.description:
The interesting stories of 44 and 99 that takes place in alternate universes.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

141689.description:
"I thought this gorgeous guy had the perfection of a Buddha?until he turned out to be terrible in bed."

Zen Arinaga works at a brokerage. Upon transferring to a different office, he falls in love at first sight with his new boss, Hideaki Takarada! The guy's straight, but Zen goes through every trick in the book to win him over. His hard work pays off at last, but when it's time to get down and dirty... "Am I being tested? Or is this divine punishment?" His boss is ridiculously pure, which throws the naturally devilish Zen for a loop. Now he's on a quest to make enlightened love with his beloved boss!

(Source: Renta!)

title.romaji: Bosatsu Kachou: BO SA TSU KACHO

141690.description: In spite of his youth, the painter Kim Hong-Do has been recognized as the greatest painter in Joseon (Korea). In the midst of wallowing in the pleasures of wine and women, he received an important mission from the king. Why did he end up in Japan? What is the secret of a landscape painting in Osaka Castle? Can this debauched painter succeed in his task?

141691.description:
The cold corporate president who no longer believed in love after having lost it once before. The gentle boy forced to be strong trying to hold on to love. Two unrelated people are fated to meet as alpha and omega. Confrontation, conflict, reconciliation, and coming together… Is this fatal attraction a cruel joke of the devil, or a grace from god?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

141692.description:
The second in the “Sexcape Room” series!
Yu-Jin is the new guy at work with a boss who harps on him constantly. It’s not that Eun-Jae is a horrible boss; she simply catches Yu-Jin at his worst moments because his luck is horrible. In fact, he’s so unlucky that he ends up in a room that he can only escape if he has sex with Eun-Jae. Will Yu-Jin’s luck and his relationship with his boss improve as they try to break out together?

(Source: Lezhin X, edited)
synonyms: If You Don't, the Room Will Grow
If You Don't, the Room Will Stretch

141693.description:
He's the top man at Kuaichuan Systems, jumping into different worlds and playing the role of the innocent nice guy to perfection. With his adorable looks and manipulative nature, he made movie stars, corporate presidents, even emperors fall for him, always with the perfect happy ending. But it turned out that it's the same person he's been seducing every time? In this man-versus-man war of love, who will be the final victor?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: Brilliantly Beautiful White Lotus Teaching Online

title.romaji: (Kuai Chuan) Jue Mei Bailian Zaixian Jiaoxue

141694.description:
An arrogant, overconfident jerk and a stubborn pessimist are partners in comedy.

"Edge" is an up-and-coming comedy duo comprising of Sakae (the straight man) and Ittoh (the funny man). Ittoh's loose with money and women, which Sakae can't stand. In fact, the duo are known throughout show business for not getting along. Fed up, Sakae decides to tell his partner off, only to be held down and kissed! Ittoh tells Sakae that if he wants to accept him as his partner, he'll need to accept everything about him. Finding Ittoh attractive somewhere deep down, Sakae can't gather the strength to fight him off!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

title.english: My Partner Is an Absolute Scumbag
title.native: 俺の相方がクズすぎる
title.romaji: Ore no Aikata ga Kuzu Sugiru

141695.description:
Kouki comes across as the perfect student, but deep down he has a penchant for torture that he keeps in check.
However it doesn't take long for Tobari, the new superintendent, to learn his secret!
Tobari shows his conniving side and has Kouki help him with his work in exchange for his silence. Kouki's desires start to overwhelm him, and soon he develops a need to dominate Tobari...

A dormitory romance that begins with the tying of a different knot!

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters

141696.description:
Yukari is a big guy with a motherly disposition who works in a restaurant at the university. He takes notice of Sasara, who is mysterious yet prickly. As Yukari walks home, his mind on Sasara, he is suddenly kidnapped by a large wolf, who carries him to a small shrine where a "fallen deity" is enshrined. As he is taken into the shrine, Yukari finds out that the wolf is actually Sasara. Sasara pushes him down, saying they're about to mate, and begins to pull off his clothes. Yukari finds himself overcome by desire and feels an overwhelming urge to claim Sasara...

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

141697.description:
The 9-year-old boy, who lives in a mansion surrounded by servants, is interested in Tanaka, who is the only Asian. He says that it is rare for him to come from Japan, the country of NINJA, and that he only cares about that. One day, the boy who bardged into the servant's room accidentally falls in love when he sees Tanaka without his hair flicked back. Later, at the request of the boy, Tanaka became his exclusive caretaker.

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.
141697.hashtag: #金髪お坊ちゃまと日本人執事

title.native: 金髪お坊ちゃまと日本人執事

141698.description:
A 35 year-old widow married the land god, who had been watching over the land for a long time without ever marrying. While spending time together, the god was captivated by her pure charm..!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)
synonyms: 村で一番若い女を嫁に
Mura de Ichiban Wakai Onna wo Yome ni

title.native: 土地神と、村で一番若い嫁
title.romaji: Tochigami to, Mura de Ichiban Wakaiyome

141700.description: In Karakura Town, there has been a sudden outbreak of unidentifiable spirits called "blanks" (vacant souls) while in the skies of Soul Society, the real world has been reflected. A mysterious female shinigami called Senna has appeared before Ichigo along with a man named Ganryu, leading a group called the "Dark Ones."
synonyms: Bleach the Movie: Memories of Nobody

141701.description: A valuable artifact known as "King's Seal" ("Ouin") is stolen by a mysterious group of people during transport in the Soul Society. Toshiro Hitsugaya, the 10th Division Captain of Gotei 13, is assigned to transport the seal, fights the leader of the group, and shortly after, goes missing. After the incident, the Seireitei declares Hitsugaya a traitor and orders the capture and execution of Hitsugaya. Ichigo Kurosaki refuses to believe this, and along with Rangiku Matsumoto, Rukia Kuchiki, and Renji Abarai, swears to uncover the real mastermind of the stolen seal, find Hitsugaya, and clear his name. Meanwhile, a rogue Hitsugaya searches for the perpetrators and uncovers a dark secret regarding a long dead shinigami.
synonyms: Bleach the Movie: The DiamondDust Rebellion

title.native: BLEACH The DiamondDust Rebellion もう一つの氷輪丸
title.romaji: BLEACH: The DiamondDust Rebellion - Mou Hitotsu no Hyourinmaru

141702.description: A mysterious reiatsu (spiritual particle) explosion occurs in the center of Seireitei in Soul Society, causing it to be destroyed. At the exact same time, a major change overwhelms Kuchiki Rukia, which leaves her losing something important inside. Urahara Kisuke sends Kurosaki Ichigo to Soul Society to investigate the disturbance. Upon reaching Seireitei, Ichigo is set upon and attacked by shinigamis, once allies, who have no memory of him and Rukia. Now alone and on the run, Ichigo must find the missing Rukia and uncover the cause of the mysterious incident before it's too late.
synonyms: Bleach the Movie: Fade to Black

title.native: BLEACH Fade to Black 君の名を呼ぶ
title.romaji: BLEACH: Fade to Black - Kimi no Na wo Yobu

141703.description: Bleach: Jigoku-hen is set in Hell and features a fully Hollowfied Ichigo. The movie centers around Ichigo and his friends heading into Hell with the assistance of man named Kokuto to stop the merging of the two realms. However, Kokuto gives Ichigo a warning - he mustn't Hollowfy in Hell, or he will lose control of his body and never be able to return...

141704.description:
"Marry me, just for show."

Seishiro Kyogoku, son and personal secretary of the incumbent Minister of Justice, found himself utterly baffled. First, his young half-brother Reo came to live with him! Then, an out-of-the-blue reunion with his old classmate Takeru Kyogoku led to Takeru finding out the truth about Reo!! And to top it off, now he's managed to get himself stuck in a sham marriage with Takeru!!! While breaking the news, Seishiro vows to put Takeru and Reo's wellbeing even above his own life, sham or not, but then Takeru pushes him down on the bed and demands a different sort of consolation prize for going along with this plan......
Can real love bloom from a union born of lies?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

141705.description:
Dowan Ha is a bullied gamer, whose bullies force him to grind to obtain in-game items for them. After one such bully demands that Dowan obtain an impossibly rare item for him or be beaten in front of the prettiest girl in school, Dowan games day and night for a week until he drops dead from exhaustion. However, as soon as he dies, he respawns back in his classroom one week before his death. Everything is the same as it was before, except now he has all the skills he’s acquired from the games he’s played in real life! Will Dowan be able to use his newfound abilities and gamified existence to defeat his bullies?

(Source: WEBTOON)

141706.description:
Yoji Tsuchiya's an omega aggravated by his love for Jin Arumi, a beta.
He hopes that one day, he and Jin will be more than best friends... but for the time being, he'll do anything to protect the status quo. Yoji spends most of his time getting through the gauntlet that is Jin's innocent teasing. One day, though, Yoji goes into heat right in front of Jin...!
He doesn't want Jin to hate him... but... maybe he can use this to his advantage... An omega's true nature wavering somewhere between friendship and desire.
What's waiting for the two once they cross that line...!?

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: Carnal Desire Overflow -More Than Best Friends, Not Quite Boyfriends-
title.native: 劣情オーバーフロー～親友以上、彼氏未満～
title.romaji: Retsujou Overflow: Shinyu Ijou, Kareshi Miman

141707.description: The story centers on Sadachika, an Edo period samurai who is obsessed with ukiyo-e art. In an effort to teach him the ways of winning over women, Sadachika's father takes him to one of the most desired courtesans of the Yoshiwara red light district, the high-ranking tayū Murasaki. Sadachika is nervous when he meets Murasaki, but what ends up starting their relationship is Sadachika's home-made cooking.

141708.description:
Seung-ju helps the handsome man who was fallen on the road due to a heat stroke. However, the young man who comes to his senses has amnesia. Seungju eventually brings him in at 'Dongbangmi-in', a rice cake restaurant quietly located in the alley. Even if Seung-ju is harsh and cold, he always comes to him with a bright smile. “I can't recall my memories. So let me remember using my body."

(Source: Bookcube, translated)

141709.description:
Born with the ability to change people’s moods, Lee Boknam was used to getting whatever he wanted. But when he inexplicably loses his powers at age 29, his flawless, comfortable life is turned upside down. The only clue is a mysterious letter from a woman named So Nagi. Desperate for answers, he tracks down Nagi in a rural town, where he learns that to prevent an early death, he must live an ordinary life. Now completely powerless, can Boknam adjust to life in the real world?

(Source: Tapas)

141710.description:
Masafuyu Mizutani, a newly minted associate professor, finds his lab hijacked when the university's star student, Ryogo Amatsuka, exploits a certain secret of his. Mizutani braces himself for a year researching one-on-one with the brilliant troublemaker, who seems determined to tease him in sexy new ways at every turn…!

(Source: Animate International)

title.english: My Student Is So Not Cute
title.native: 俺の生徒はかわいくない

141711.description:
Takuma Kaido's down on his luck and gets into a motorcycle accident, causing him to have to spend time in a hospital.
At the hospital, he reunites with Leo, the guy he had a passionate one-night stand with the day before. Takuma's smitten with Leo, who's a nurse, but Leo focuses on his job and gives him the cold shoulder. The reason for that is because Takuma said something careless and made Kaido mad at him...

In addition to this naughty cover story centered on medical fetishes, this book also includes "Pleasure Triangle," which is about a love triangle battle in a school!!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: He's a Nurse and He's Especially Hard on Me
title.native: ナースな彼は俺にだけ厳しめ
title.romaji: Nurse na Kare ha Ore ni dake Kibishime

141712.description:
Tohko Amano is a perfectly ordinary Book Girl-she loves stories so much that she devours them. But some stories are too intense even for the specialists. Mysterious coded messages start to appear hinting that a ghost is stalking the school, and what can Tohko do but try to defend the book club from it? She's the president, even if she is a little . . . terrified. But when the ghost turns out to be a real girl with two souls, hovering on the edge of life and death, light and darkness, love and hatred, the Book Girl's skills-and those of Konoha, the trusty, level-headed Watson to her Sherlock Holmes-might be the only way to solve the mystery.

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: สาวน้อยวรรณกรรม กับวิญญาณหิวกระหาย

title.english: Book Girl and the Famished Spirit
title.native: “文学少女”と飢え渇く幽霊【ゴースト】

141713.description:
"Hey! There are pages missing in this book!" One day Tohko borrows a book from the library, but there are pages missing--sliced right out of it. There's no way the Book Girl, who loves books so much that she devours them, is going to stay silent about this! Caught up in Tohko's rampage, Konoha and his classmate Akutagawa are even forced (though they have no idea why) to perform a play for the school's culture fair. But Tohko and Konoha glimpse the darkness in his classmate's heart and of the madness that has driven him into a corner. A soul stands immobilized, bound up by the mistakes of the past. Will the Book Girl be able to set it free?

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: สาวน้อยวรรณกรรม กับคนโง่ผู้ถูกจองจำ

title.english: Book Girl and the Captive Fool
title.native: “文学少女”と繋がれた愚者【フール】

141714.description:
Ha-Buk Paeng Family’s best strength, Ji-Hyuk Paeng heads to the Nakho Region to save his family that fell into destruction due to the attack of the Demon Sect, but everything was a trap. At the moment of death, he felt the wrath of being the only one left from his beloved family.

"Again…if you give me a chance…!”

Paeng Ji-Hyuk, who thought he was dead, woke up in the body of Young Master Sa, of the Paeng Family.

141715.description:
With college exams approaching, Tohko Amano - president of the literary club, closet book-eating goblin, and shameless procrastinator - does the unthinkable and declares club activities suspended! Unencumbered by the demand of his taskmistress to deliver handwritten improv stories, Konoha finds himself helping his oft-estranged classmate, Nanase Kotobuki, in the music room after school. When one of Kotobuki's friends goes missing before Christmas, though - vanishing amidst rumors of her being an "Angel of Music" - Konoha finds himself swept up in a mystery unfolding as if from the pages of Gaston Leroux's seminal work...

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: สาวน้อยวรรณกรรม กับนางฟ้าผู้ต้องมลทิน
文學少女 背負污名的天使

title.english: Book Girl and the Corrupted Angel
title.native: “文学少女”と穢名の天使【アンジュ】

141716.description:
Taboo! Teacher + Student in a financial relationship!

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Shitsurakuten 2021-11

title.english: The Teacher and His Landmine of a Student That Sucked Him Dry
title.native: 吸われる先生の俺と吸い取る生徒の地雷系女子
title.romaji: Suwareru Sensei no Ore to Suitoru Seito no Jirai-kei Joshi

141717.description:
"I am Tohko Amano. As you can see, I am a Book Girl." It's been two years since Konoha's first encounter with Tohko, the mysterious girl who introduced herself so oddly. The two have shared any number of unusual adventures int he interim, but as Tohko's graduation approaches, she inadvertently confesses a betrayal. Stunned by this revelation, Konoha is further rattled by a warning that his club president will soon disappear! What is the secret that Tohko has kept hidden? The first act in the finale of Konoha and Tohko's story begins here!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: "Bungaku Shoujo" to Kami ni Nozomu Romanciere
สาวน้อยวรรณกรรม นักเขียนผู้เผชิญหน้ากับพระเจ้า

title.english: Book Girl and the Scribe Who Faced God
title.native: “文学少女”と神に臨む作家【ロマンシエ】
title.romaji: "Bungaku Shoujo" to Kami ni Nozomu Romancière

141720.description:
Let's show off... ❤ our depravity!

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2021-12

synonyms: Nonomi-chan's Secret Account -Perverted Trip to a Private Hotspring-

title.native: 裏垢やってる乃ノ美ちゃん -個室温泉ドスケベ合宿-
title.romaji: Uraaka Yatteru Nonomi-chan: Koshitsu Onsen Dosukebe Gasshuku

141723.description:
Tohko will be graduating soon. Although that thought makes him sad, when he spends New Year's with Kotobuki, Konoha feels the distance between them closing ever so slightly. However, when he hears that Kotobuki has been suddenly hospitalized and goes to visit her, he is reunited with a girl he never for a moment forgot! A girl who smiles exactly like she used to. However, Konoha's bonds with those around him begin to creak loudly, and she is at the center of it all. What exactly is the truth? What is it that she wishes for? What are the girl's true feelings, as the Book Girl imagines them? The long-awaited fifth volume!

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: สาวน้อยวรรณกรรม กับนักแสวงหาผู้เศร้าสร้อย
文學少女 絕望慟哭的信徒

title.english: Book Girl and the Wayfarer's Lamentation
title.native: “文学少女”と慟哭の巡礼者【パルミエーレ】

141724.description:
"I've been kidnapped by a bad person. Bring a change of clothes and your homework and come save me!" Duped by this seemingly earnest summons from Tohko, Konoha finds himself forced to spend his summer break at the Himekura villa, writing snacks for his greedy club president. But the shadow of a tragedy from eighty years past threatens to destroy their otherwise peaceful summer! What is the "secret" that stirs the Book Girl's imagination?

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: สาวน้อยวรรณกรรมกับเทพธิดาแห่งวารี
文學少女 懷抱花月的水妖

title.english: Book Girl and the Undine Who Bore a Moonflower
title.native: “文学少女”と月花を孕く水妖【ウンディーネ】
title.romaji: "Bungaku Shoujo" to Tsukihana wo Taku Ondine

141726.description:
Making a feisty classmate submit by touching her down there and making her come!? It's my job as the class president to give this delinquent girl some extra guidance...

(Source: Coolmic)

Before you know it, you’ll master difficult concepts like inertial frames of reference, unified spacetime, and the equivalence principle. You’ll see how relativity affects modern astronomy and discover why GPS systems and other everyday technologies depend on Einstein’s extraordinary discovery.

The Manga Guide to Relativity also teaches you how to:
Understand and use E = mc2, the world’s most famous equation
Calculate the effects of time dilation using the Pythagorean theorem
Understand classic thought experiments like the Twin Paradox, and see why length contracts and mass increases at relativistic speeds
Grasp the underpinnings of Einstein’s special and general theories of relativity

If the idea of bending space and time really warps your brain, let The Manga Guide to Relativity straighten things out.

Genzo, no longer able to earn money from its fights, turned Musashi into a bait dog. Musashi was muzzled and blindfolded to be attacked by other dogs, but Haruhiko was struck by the way Musashi tried his best to fight, and decided to return him to dogfighting. A comeback match against the fearsome Muramasa was arranged through the Nishiyama, an influential figure in the local dogfighting scene. Musashi narrowly won, but was forced to retire due to injuries sustained in the fight. After that, Musashi began to attack Masamune, a newly acquired fighting dog, every night. Haruhiko's father, annoyed by the dog's refusal to listen to his repeated warnings, finally killed Musashi with a gun! One year later, when they saw Masamune fight for the first time, they were surprised to see that his fighting style was similar to Musashi's. All that time, Musashi had been teaching his own techniques to train the younger dogs. Genzo regretted his actions and closed his dogfighting business, while Haruhiko wept and apologized at Musashi's grave. A tragedy between humans and animals who couldn't properly communicate, comes to a close...

Shirara and Mimumu are first place and second place respectively in their magic school. In order to earn good grades in their transformation class, they want to reproduce "every nook and cranny" of the transformation subject. Dragon, unicorn, incubus, kraken, demon, slime... just how do their penises look like? And so, these two girls start their ecological research in this other world.

Note: Chapter count includes 1 extra chapter.

title.native: ミムムとシララ ～ドラゴンのちんちんを見に行こう～
title.romaji: Mimumu to Shirara: Dragon no Chinchin wo Mi ni Ikou

141995.description:
Anthology of one-shots published in The Margaret.

1. Saiai no Kimi e (最愛の君へ) by Ayu Fujimiya
A first love story that began with a poem.

2. Stalking GOGO (ストーキングGOGO) by Aida Natsumi
I want to know everything about the girl I fell in love with!

3. Natsuhiro Hanabi (夏色花火) by Rin Mamiya
A night of fireworks. Will her love for her childhood friend reach him?

4. Honey Filter (ハニー・フィルター) by Ayumi Komura
The delusional love story of a super-optimistic girl.

5. Otsukaresama (おつかれさま) by Sono Kisaragi
A dead girl haunts the boy she loves...

6. Shounen Bambi (少年バンビ) by Mako Takahashi
Her boyfriend is cuter than her...

141996.description:
In the first year of Reiwa, Keitarou Maebara moves from Tokyo to Hinamizawa. He is excited about his new life in Hinamizawa as he gets to know the children of the former club members. Then one day, he meets a mysterious girl named Inori, and another girl who calls herself Kururu contacts Keitarou... Oyashiro-sama's curse transcends time and generations, and will happen again in the world of Reiwa...?

(Source: Big Gangan, translated)

141999.description: The story depicts a stifling workplace quarrel between two roommates in a small company's bachelor dormitory. The quarrel is resolved with mutual understanding and recognition of the other's personality.
